content.title: About
content.content: Cookie with marshmallow and coconut is a soft biscuit that incorporates sweet marshmallow pieces and aromatic shredded coconut. It combines a crisp base, a creamy marshmallow flavor, and a light tropical hint of coconut.

content.title: Interesting Facts
items: Marshmallow was originally invented in ancient Egypt as a medicinal remedy.
Coconut shreds are rich in dietary fiber and give the cookie its distinctive aroma.
The sweet marshmallow‑coconut combo is popular in Asian desserts such as Thai coconut rice with marshmallow.
Marshmallow cookies are often used as a base for ice‑cream sandwich desserts.
Shredded coconut can be used dry or lightly toasted, changing the texture of the final product.

items.title: Energy source
items.content: The sugars and carbohydrates in the cookie provide quick energy for the body.

items.title: Rich in fiber
items.content: Coconut shreds contain dietary fiber that supports healthy digestion.

items.title: Contains iron
items.content: Marshmallow, made from gelatin, can contribute small amounts of iron.

items.title: B‑vitamins
items.content: Flour and sugar supply modest amounts of B1, B2, and B3 vitamins, aiding metabolism.

items.title: Mood booster
items.content: The sweet taste and coconut aroma can stimulate serotonin production, improving mood.

items.title: Coconut allergy
items.content: Some individuals may experience allergic reactions to coconut shreds.

items.title: High sugar content
items.content: The cookie is high in sugar and should be consumed in moderation, especially by people with diabetes.

items.title: Gluten presence
items.content: Traditional recipes use wheat flour, making it unsuitable for gluten‑free diets.

items.title: Gelatin in marshmallow
items.content: Marshmallow often contains gelatin derived from animal bones; vegetarians should look for alternatives.

content.title: How to Eat
content.content: Enjoy the cookie as a snack, crumble it into ice cream, use it in dessert cakes, or simply pair it with a cup of tea.

content.title: Storage
content.content: Store the cookies in an airtight container in a cool, dry place. For longer shelf life, keep them in the refrigerator to maintain crispness and prevent staleness.
